newsitem.title: GREECE: NATL BANK SELLS HALYPS METALLURGY TO SOVEL.
newsitem.headline: NATL BANK SELLS HALYPS METALLURGY TO SOVEL.

text.p: Halyps Metallurgy which has been dormant for five years has been sold by National Bank subsidiary National Capital to Sovel SA, the bank said in a statement.
"The final contract for the transfer of Halyps Metallurgy SA's factory at Almyros in Volos to Sovel SA was signed today," National Bank said.
Sovel's major shareholder is the Viohalko Group with an 85 percent stake. More specifically, Sidenor has 45 percent, Viohalko 30 percent and other group companies have a 10 percent stake.
National Bank holds 15 percent of Sovel's share capital. Sovel starts with a share capital of 8.0 billion drachmas and the investment will reach 18 billion, National Bank said.
Halyps Metallurgy's plant in Almyros will resume operations soon offering employment opportunities in Magnisia, the bank said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
